BiblicalUsage: Azaliah was the father of Shaphan the scribe, and both passages name him the same way, as the man King Josiah sent to repair the house of the LORD. The book of the law was found during that work, and his son carried it to the king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a father's name is remembered here because his son was in the room when the lost book was found, and the reform that followed began with a family that served the house of God.
